about: PLA-461 local implementation pass (2026-09-08): bounded CANDIDATE repair of the two
formerly failing Guide explanation cases (attempted-solution diagnosis, simpler
explanation), measured on the production class_chat planner/tool loop
endpoint. The prompt change is a candidate for parent integration; nothing here
asserts packaged-candidate or issue completion. Raw per-run workspaces (runs/grades/
meta JSON) live in the gitignored data/local-guide-eval/ of the Lyra-local-guide
worktree; this directory carries the sanitized compact record (this file) plus
transcripts.json (full sanitized terminal text, case context, tool arguments/results,
and grading for every run) and the versioned held-out fixture. All corpus content is
synthetic; no endpoint URL, key, or student data is retained - locality class only.
Same-model (same-endpoint) judging is supporting evidence, not independent review;
the parent's independent reading of the retained terminal text is recorded in
independent_review below and in the main document.
